title: Semantic Trimming and Auxiliary Multi-step Prediction for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2604.05329v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) has recently transitioned from atomic item-indexing to Semantic ID (SID)-based frameworks to capture intrinsic item relationships and enhance generalization. However, the adoption of high-granularity SIDs leads to two critical challenges: prohibitive training overhead due to sequence expansion and unstable performance reliability characterized by non-monotonic accuracy fluctuations. We identify that these disparate issues are fundamentally rooted in the Semantic Dilution Effect, where redundant tokens waste massive computation and dilute the already sparse learning signals in recommendation. To counteract this, we propose STAMP (Semantic Trimming and Auxiliary Multi-step Prediction), a framework utilizing a dual-end optimization strategy. translated_title: 语义修剪与辅助多步预测用于生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）最近从原子项目索引转向基于语义ID（SID）的框架，以捕捉内在项目关系并增强泛化能力。然而，采用高粒度SID带来了两个关键挑战：由于序列扩展导致的过高训练开销，以及以非单调精度波动为特征的不稳定性能可靠性。我们识别出这些看似不同的问题根本上源于语义稀释效应，其中冗余令牌浪费大量计算并稀释了推荐中本已稀疏的学习信号。为解决这一问题，我们提出STAMP（语义修剪与辅助多步预测），一个利用双端优化策略的框架。我们认为有效的SID学习需要同时解决低输入信息密度和稀疏输出监督的问题。在输入侧，我们引入语义自适应修剪机制。
tldr: 本文提出STAMP框架，通过语义修剪和辅助多步预测的双端优化策略，解决生成式推荐中语义稀释效应导致的训练开销和性能不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STAMP, a dual-end optimization framework with semantic trimming and auxiliary multi-step prediction, to address the semantic dilution effect causing training overhead and unstable performance in generative recommendation.
